_comment: DRAFTS written by Claude for human review. Every recipe must be reviewed and cook-tested before published = true (PRD §11.2).

recipes.name: Chicken livers peri-peri & pap
recipes.description: Peri-peri chicken livers in tomato sauce with pap.
steps: Cook the pap.
Fry onion and garlic, add the livers and brown quickly.
Add tomatoes and peri-peri spice; simmer 10 minutes.
Serve on pap.

recipes.name: Egg & potato curry
recipes.description: Boiled eggs and potatoes in a tomato curry, with rice.
steps: Boil the eggs 10 minutes and peel.
Fry onion, add curry powder, tomatoes and diced potatoes; simmer 20 minutes.
Add the halved eggs and warm through.
Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Beef stew & dumplings
recipes.description: Slow beef stew with carrots, topped with steamed dumplings.
steps: Brown the beef in oil, add onion, then water, stock and soup powder; simmer 1 hour.
Add carrots and potatoes.
Mix flour, baking powder, salt and water into a soft dough; drop spoonfuls on top.
Cover and steam 20 minutes without lifting the lid.

recipes.name: Lentil curry & rice
recipes.description: Red lentil curry with tomato and spinach.
steps: Fry onion, garlic and curry powder.
Add lentils, tomatoes and water; simmer 20 minutes until soft.
Stir in the spinach for the last 3 minutes.
Serve on rice.

recipes.name: Tuna pasta
recipes.description: Creamy tuna pasta with peas.
steps: Cook the pasta, adding the peas for the last 3 minutes.
Drain, keeping a splash of water.
Stir through the tuna, mayonnaise and a little pasta water.
Season with pepper.

recipes.name: Chicken & veg pot
recipes.description: One-pot chicken with potatoes, carrots and cabbage.
steps: Brown the chicken with onion.
Add potatoes, carrots, stock and water; simmer 30 minutes.
Add the cabbage and cook 10 more minutes.
Season and serve.

recipes.name: Pap & wors with tomato gravy
recipes.description: Boerewors and stiff pap with a quick tomato and onion gravy.
steps: Cook stiff pap.
Fry the wors until done.
Fry onion and tomato with a pinch of sugar until saucy.
Serve wors and gravy on pap.

recipes.name: Spinach & pilchard stew
recipes.description: Pilchards and spinach in tomato, served with pap.
steps: Cook the pap.
Fry onion, add the pilchards with their sauce and the tomato.
Add chopped spinach and simmer 10 minutes.
Serve with pap.

recipes.name: Pasta with mince & tomato
recipes.description: Everyday mince and tomato pasta.
steps: Brown the mince with onion and garlic.
Add tinned tomatoes, paste and herbs; simmer 15 minutes.
Cook the pasta.
Toss together and serve.

recipes.name: Chicken feet stew & pap
recipes.description: Slow-cooked chicken feet in a spicy tomato gravy.
steps: Clean the feet and boil 20 minutes; drain.
Fry onion and curry powder, add tomatoes, stock and the feet.
Simmer 30 minutes until tender.
Serve with pap.

recipes.name: Chicken curry & rice
recipes.description: Mild chicken and potato curry.
steps: Fry onion, garlic and curry powder in oil.
Add the chicken and brown.
Add tomatoes, potatoes and water; simmer 30 minutes.
Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Chicken mince bolognaise
recipes.description: Lighter bolognaise made with chicken mince.
steps: Brown the chicken mince with onion and carrot.
Add tomatoes, paste and herbs; simmer 15 minutes.
Cook the pasta.
Serve the sauce on the pasta.

recipes.name: Oven drumsticks & potatoes
recipes.description: Spiced drumsticks roasted on a tray with potato wedges.
steps: Heat the oven to 200 °C.
Toss drumsticks and potato wedges in oil and braai spice.
Roast 45 minutes, turning once.
Serve with a quick tomato and onion salad.

recipes.name: Polony & egg fried rice
recipes.description: Fried rice with polony, egg and peas.
steps: Cook the rice (or use yesterday's).
Fry diced polony and onion.
Push aside, scramble the eggs, then add peas and rice.
Season and toss until hot.

recipes.name: Viennas & beans on pap
recipes.description: Viennas in baked beans with soft pap.
steps: Cook the pap.
Slice viennas and fry with onion.
Add baked beans and warm through.
Serve on pap.

recipes.name: Pork chops, cabbage & mash
recipes.description: Pan-fried pork chops with mash and cabbage.
steps: Boil and mash the potatoes with margarine and milk.
Season and fry the chops 5 minutes a side.
Fry the cabbage with onion until soft.
Serve together.

recipes.name: Sausage & potato bake
recipes.description: Pork sausages baked with potatoes and onions.
steps: Heat the oven to 200 °C.
Toss sliced potatoes and onion in oil and herbs in a tray.
Add the sausages and bake 40 minutes.
Serve hot.

recipes.name: Pan-fried hake & potato wedges
recipes.description: Crisp hake fillets with pan-fried wedges and peas.
steps: Par-boil the potato wedges 8 minutes and drain.
Fry the wedges in oil until golden.
Dust the hake in seasoned flour and fry 3 minutes a side.
Serve with peas.

recipes.name: Tuna fried rice
recipes.description: Fried rice with tuna, egg and mixed veg.
steps: Cook the rice.
Fry onion and the mixed veg.
Add the rice and tuna, then scrambled egg.
Season and serve.

recipes.name: Cottage pie
recipes.description: Mince and veg topped with mash and baked.
steps: Brown the mince with onion and carrots; add tomatoes and soup powder.
Boil and mash the potatoes with margarine and milk.
Spread the mince in a dish, top with mash.
Bake at 180 °C for 25 minutes.

recipes.name: Samp & mince
recipes.description: Soft samp with a savoury mince stew.
steps: Soak and boil the samp about 1 hour until soft.
Brown the mince with onion and carrot.
Add tomatoes and stock; simmer 15 minutes.
Serve the mince on the samp.

recipes.name: Butternut & lentil soup with bread
recipes.description: Thick butternut and lentil soup with bread.
steps: Fry onion and curry powder.
Add diced butternut, lentils, stock and water; simmer 25 minutes.
Mash or blend until thick.
Serve with bread.

recipes.name: Sugar bean curry & rice
recipes.description: Hearty sugar bean curry.
steps: Soak the beans overnight, then boil 50 minutes until soft.
Fry onion, garlic and curry powder; add tomatoes.
Add the beans and simmer 15 minutes.
Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Bean & potato curry
recipes.description: Butter beans and potatoes in a mild curry.
steps: Fry onion and curry powder.
Add potatoes, tomatoes and water; simmer 15 minutes.
Add the butter beans; simmer 5 minutes.
Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Stovetop macaroni & cheese
recipes.description: Creamy macaroni cheese made in one pot.
steps: Cook the macaroni.
Melt margarine, stir in flour, then whisk in milk until thick.
Stir in the grated cheese.
Mix with the pasta and serve.

recipes.name: Tomato & egg stew with pap
recipes.description: Eggs poached in a tomato and onion stew.
steps: Cook the pap.
Fry onion and green pepper, add tomatoes and simmer 10 minutes.
Make hollows and crack in the eggs; cover until set.
Serve with pap.

recipes.name: Chicken breyani
recipes.description: One-pot rice, chicken, lentils and potatoes.
steps: Brown the chicken with onion and spices.
Add tomatoes and potatoes; simmer 15 minutes.
Add rice, lentils and water; cover and cook on low 30 minutes.
Fluff and serve.

recipes.name: Mince & potato curry with bread
recipes.description: Mince curry with potato, mopped up with bread.
steps: Fry onion and curry powder, add mince and brown.
Add tomatoes and potatoes with water.
Simmer 20 minutes.
Serve with bread.

recipes.name: Chakalaka, beans & pap
recipes.description: Chakalaka and baked beans warmed together with pap.
steps: Cook the pap.
Fry onion, add chakalaka and baked beans.
Simmer 5 minutes.
Serve on pap.

recipes.name: Spinach, eggs & pap
recipes.description: Wilted spinach with onion and scrambled eggs, on pap.
steps: Cook the pap.
Fry onion and tomato, add chopped spinach until wilted.
Scramble the eggs separately.
Serve together.

recipes.name: Chicken liver curry & rice
recipes.description: Quick chicken liver curry.
steps: Fry onion, garlic and curry powder.
Add the livers and brown.
Add tomatoes; simmer 10 minutes.
Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Pilchard curry & rice
recipes.description: Pilchards in a quick tomato curry.
steps: Fry onion and curry powder.
Add tomatoes and simmer 5 minutes.
Add the pilchards and warm through gently.
Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Boerewors rolls with tomato relish
recipes.description: Wors rolls with a tomato and onion relish.
steps: Fry or braai the wors.
Cook onion and tomato with sugar until jammy.
Slice the bread or rolls.
Serve wors in bread with the relish.

recipes.name: Vetkoek & curried mince
recipes.description: Fried bread dough with curried mince.
steps: Mix flour, baking powder, salt and water into a dough; rest 20 minutes.
Cook curried mince with onion and tomato.
Fry spoonfuls of dough in hot oil until puffed and golden.
Split and fill with mince.

recipes.name: Chicken à la king & rice
recipes.description: Creamy chicken with peas and green pepper on rice.
steps: Fry diced chicken and onion.
Add green pepper, then flour, then milk; stir until thick.
Add the peas and simmer 5 minutes.
Serve on rice.

recipes.name: Chicken & veg stir-fry
recipes.description: Quick chicken and mixed veg stir-fry on rice.
steps: Cook the rice.
Fry strips of chicken in hot oil.
Add onion and mixed veg; stir-fry 5 minutes.
Season and serve.

recipes.name: Soya mince curry & rice
recipes.description: Spiced soya mince with potatoes and peas.
steps: Fry onion and curry powder.
Add soya mince, tomatoes, potatoes and water.
Simmer 15 minutes, adding the peas at the end.
Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Cabbage & potato curry
recipes.description: Simple cabbage and potato curry with bread.
steps: Fry onion, curry powder and turmeric.
Add potatoes and a little water; cook 10 minutes.
Add the cabbage and cook 10 minutes more.
Serve with bread.

recipes.name: Lentil cottage pie
recipes.description: Lentils and veg under a mash topping, baked.
steps: Simmer lentils with onion, carrot, tomatoes and stock 20 minutes.
Boil and mash the potatoes with margarine.
Top the lentils with mash in a dish.
Bake at 180 °C for 25 minutes.

recipes.name: Beef stew & samp
recipes.description: Slow beef stew on soft samp.
steps: Boil soaked samp about 1 hour.
Brown the beef with onion; add stock and soup powder.
Simmer 1 hour, adding carrots for the last 20 minutes.
Serve on samp.

recipes.name: Chicken & vegetable soup with bread
recipes.description: A thick chicken soup with veg and bread.
steps: Simmer the chicken in water with stock 25 minutes.
Remove bones, add carrots, potatoes, onion and cabbage.
Simmer 15 minutes.
Serve with bread.

recipes.name: Viennas & tomato pasta
recipes.description: Kid-friendly pasta with viennas in tomato sauce.
steps: Cook the pasta.
Fry sliced viennas with onion.
Add tomatoes and paste; simmer 5 minutes.
Toss with the pasta.

recipes.name: Egg & veg fried rice
recipes.description: Meat-free fried rice with egg and mixed veg.
steps: Cook the rice.
Fry onion and mixed veg.
Add rice, then the beaten eggs, stirring.
Season and serve.

recipes.name: One-pot mince rice
recipes.description: Mince, tomato and rice cooked together jollof-style.
steps: Brown mince with onion and green pepper.
Add paprika, tomatoes and the rice; stir.
Add water, cover and cook on low 20 minutes.
Fluff and serve.

recipes.name: Peri-peri drumsticks & rice
recipes.description: Pan-cooked peri-peri drumsticks.
steps: Rub drumsticks with peri-peri spice and oil.
Brown in a covered pan, then cook on low 30 minutes, turning.
Cook the rice.
Serve with a tomato and onion salad.

recipes.name: Fish curry & rice
recipes.description: Hake fillets in a tomato curry.
steps: Fry onion, garlic and curry powder.
Add tomatoes and simmer 10 minutes.
Add the hake in chunks; simmer gently 8 minutes.
Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Tuna & potato bake
recipes.description: Layered potato, tuna and cheese bake.
steps: Par-boil sliced potatoes 8 minutes.
Make a white sauce with margarine, flour and milk.
Layer potatoes, tuna and sauce; top with cheese.
Bake at 180 °C for 30 minutes.

recipes.name: Pap & mince gravy
recipes.description: Stiff pap with a savoury mince gravy.
steps: Cook stiff pap.
Brown the mince with onion.
Add soup powder mixed with water and simmer until thick.
Serve on pap.

recipes.name: Chicken frikkadels & mash
recipes.description: Chicken mince meatballs with mash and peas.
steps: Mix the mince with grated onion, egg and bread.
Shape and fry the frikkadels until cooked.
Boil and mash the potatoes with margarine.
Serve with peas.

recipes.name: Mince macaroni bake
recipes.description: Macaroni and mince baked with cheese.
steps: Cook the macaroni.
Make a mince and tomato sauce.
Mix with the pasta in a dish and top with cheese.
Bake at 180 °C for 20 minutes.

recipes.name: Spinach & potato curry
recipes.description: Potatoes and spinach in a light curry, with rice.
steps: Fry onion, garlic and curry powder.
Add potatoes, tomatoes and water; simmer 15 minutes.
Add spinach and cook 5 minutes.
Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Chicken & samp stew
recipes.description: Chicken stewed with samp and veg.
steps: Boil soaked samp about 1 hour.
Brown the chicken with onion; add stock and carrots.
Simmer 30 minutes.
Stir together and serve.

recipes.name: Butternut & mince with rice
recipes.description: Mince with pan-cooked butternut.
steps: Cook the rice.
Fry cubed butternut in a covered pan until soft.
Brown mince with onion and add tomatoes.
Serve together.

recipes.name: Chicken tomato bredie
recipes.description: Cape-style tomato bredie with chicken and potatoes.
steps: Brown the chicken with onion.
Add tomatoes, potatoes, a pinch of sugar and water.
Simmer 40 minutes until thick.
Season and serve.

recipes.name: Beef & bean chilli with rice
recipes.description: Mince stretched with butter beans in a mild chilli.
steps: Brown mince with onion and green pepper.
Add paprika, tomatoes and butter beans.
Simmer 15 minutes.
Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Polony & potato hash
recipes.description: Fried potatoes and polony with egg.
steps: Boil diced potatoes 8 minutes and drain.
Fry with onion until crisp.
Add diced polony and warm through.
Top each plate with a fried egg.

recipes.name: Samp with chakalaka
recipes.description: Samp and beans topped with chakalaka.
steps: Boil soaked samp and beans until soft.
Season with stock.
Warm the chakalaka.
Serve chakalaka over the samp.

recipes.name: Chicken livers & pasta
recipes.description: Creamy chicken livers on pasta.
steps: Cook the pasta.
Fry onion and livers until browned.
Add a little milk and peri-peri spice; simmer 5 minutes.
Serve on pasta.

recipes.name: Lentil soup & egg sandwiches
recipes.description: Lentil and tomato soup with egg mayo sandwiches.
steps: Simmer lentils with onion, tomatoes and stock 20 minutes.
Boil, peel and mash the eggs with mayonnaise.
Make sandwiches.
Serve with the soup.

recipes.name: Pork chops, rice & peas
recipes.description: Pan-fried chops with rice and peas.
steps: Cook the rice.
Season and fry the chops.
Cook the peas.
Serve with gravy from the pan.

recipes.name: Hake fishcakes & salad
recipes.description: Hake and potato fishcakes with tomato salad.
steps: Poach the hake and flake it.
Boil and mash the potatoes; mix with fish, egg and onion.
Shape and fry in oil.
Serve with tomato and onion salad.

recipes.name: Chicken feet curry & rice
recipes.description: Spicy chicken feet curry.
steps: Clean and boil the feet 20 minutes; drain.
Fry onion, garlic and curry powder; add tomatoes.
Add feet and simmer 30 minutes.
Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Chicken gizzard stew & pap
recipes.description: Slow-simmered gizzards in a tomato and onion gravy, served with pap.
steps: Rinse the gizzards and simmer them in salted water for 40 minutes until tender; drain.
Fry onion, garlic and green pepper in oil until soft.
Add the gizzards, tomatoes, curry powder and a stock cube with a little water; simmer 15 minutes.
Cook the pap while the stew simmers.
Serve the gizzards and gravy on the pap.

recipes.name: Peri-peri gizzards & rice
recipes.description: Tender gizzards in a spicy peri-peri tomato sauce with rice.
steps: Simmer the gizzards in salted water for 40 minutes until tender; drain.
Cook the rice.
Fry onion and garlic, add the gizzards and brown for 5 minutes.
Add tomato paste, peri-peri spice and a splash of water; cook 5 minutes until sticky.
Serve with the rice.

recipes.name: Braai-spice wings & potato wedges
recipes.description: Oven-roasted spiced chicken wings with crispy potato wedges.
steps: Heat the oven to 200 °C.
Cut the potatoes into wedges, toss with half the oil and salt, and spread on a tray.
Toss the wings with braai spice and the rest of the oil; add to a second tray.
Roast both for 40 minutes, turning once, until golden and cooked through.
Serve hot.

recipes.name: Sticky tomato wings & rice
recipes.description: Wings cooked in a pan with a sweet, sticky tomato glaze.
steps: Cook the rice.
Brown the wings in oil in a large pan, about 10 minutes.
Add garlic, tomato paste, sugar, paprika and half a cup of water.
Cover and cook 20 minutes, then uncover and reduce until sticky.
Serve the wings on the rice.

recipes.name: Creamy chicken & mushroom pasta
recipes.description: Chicken fillet and mushrooms in a light milk sauce with pasta.
steps: Boil the pasta in salted water.
Slice the chicken and fry in oil until cooked; add onion and mushrooms and fry 5 minutes.
Stir in the flour, then slowly add the milk while stirring until it thickens.
Season with salt, pepper and mixed herbs.
Toss with the drained pasta.

recipes.name: Chicken & pumpkin curry
recipes.description: Chicken pieces and pumpkin in a mild curry, with rice.
steps: Brown the chicken in oil; remove.
Fry onion, garlic, curry powder and turmeric for 2 minutes.
Return the chicken, add tomatoes and a cup of water; simmer 20 minutes.
Add cubed pumpkin and simmer 15 minutes more until soft.
Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Chicken & green bean stew
recipes.description: A homely chicken stew with green beans and potato, served on rice.
steps: Brown the chicken in oil with onion.
Add a stock cube and two cups of water; simmer 20 minutes.
Add the green beans and diced potato; simmer 15 minutes until soft.
Season with salt and pepper.
Serve on rice.

recipes.name: Drumstick & sweet potato traybake
recipes.description: Paprika drumsticks roasted with sweet potato and onion.
steps: Heat the oven to 200 °C.
Cut sweet potatoes and onion into chunks and spread on a tray.
Rub the drumsticks with oil, paprika, salt and garlic; lay on top.
Roast 45 minutes until the chicken is cooked through.
Serve from the tray.

recipes.name: Chicken livers on toast
recipes.description: Quick peri-peri livers on toasted bread.
steps: Fry onion in oil until soft.
Add the livers and fry 5 minutes, turning.
Add tomato paste, peri-peri spice and a splash of water; simmer 5 minutes.
Toast the bread and spoon the livers on top.

recipes.name: Chicken mince curry & rice
recipes.description: Mild curried chicken mince with peas, served with rice.
steps: Cook the rice.
Fry onion, garlic and curry powder in oil.
Add the chicken mince and brown, breaking it up.
Add tomatoes and peas; simmer 10 minutes.
Serve with the rice.

recipes.name: Chicken stew with dumplings
recipes.description: Chicken and carrot stew topped with steamed dumplings.
steps: Brown the chicken with onion in a large pot.
Add carrots, a stock cube and three cups of water; simmer 25 minutes.
Mix flour, baking powder, salt and enough water to make a soft dough.
Drop spoonfuls of dough on the stew, cover tightly and steam 20 minutes without lifting the lid.
Serve in bowls.

recipes.name: Creamy spinach chicken & pap
recipes.description: Chicken simmered with spinach in a light milk sauce, with pap.
steps: Brown the chicken with onion and garlic.
Add a cup of water and simmer 25 minutes.
Add chopped spinach and milk; simmer 10 minutes.
Cook the pap meanwhile.
Serve the chicken and spinach with pap.

recipes.name: Toasted chicken mayo sandwiches
recipes.description: Pan-toasted sandwiches filled with chicken, mayo and cheese.
steps: Poach the chicken in salted water for 12 minutes; shred.
Mix with mayonnaise, black pepper and grated cheese.
Fill the bread, spread the outsides thinly with margarine.
Toast in a pan on both sides until golden.

recipes.name: Drumsticks, pumpkin & pap
recipes.description: Braai-spice drumsticks cooked in a pot, with sweet pumpkin and pap.
steps: Rub the drumsticks with braai spice and brown in oil.
Add a cup of water, cover and cook 30 minutes until done.
Boil cubed pumpkin with a little sugar and margarine until soft; mash.
Cook the pap.
Serve the drumsticks with pumpkin and pap.

recipes.name: Peanut chicken stew & rice
recipes.description: A rich groundnut-style chicken stew with tomato, served with rice.
steps: Brown the chicken with onion and garlic.
Add tomatoes and a cup of water; simmer 25 minutes.
Stir in the peanut butter and cook 10 minutes more, stirring so it doesn't catch.
Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Mogodu (tripe) & pap
recipes.description: Slow-cooked beef tripe with onion and curry, served with pap.
steps: Rinse the cleaned tripe well and cut into pieces.
Cover with water, add salt and simmer about 2 hours until very tender, topping up water.
Fry onion and curry powder in oil and stir into the tripe with a stock cube; cook 15 minutes.
Cook the pap.
Serve the mogodu with pap.

recipes.name: Tripe curry & rice
recipes.description: Tender tripe and potato in a tomato curry, with rice.
steps: Simmer the tripe in salted water about 2 hours until tender.
Fry onion, garlic and curry powder; add tomatoes.
Add the tripe and diced potato with a little cooking liquid; simmer 20 minutes.
Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Corned meat & cabbage with rice
recipes.description: Corned meat fried with cabbage and onion, a quick pantry supper.
steps: Cook the rice.
Fry onion in oil, add shredded cabbage and cook 8 minutes.
Add the corned meat, break it up and heat through with black pepper.
Serve with the rice.

recipes.name: Corned meat & potato hash
recipes.description: Crispy fried potatoes with corned meat, onion and a fried egg.
steps: Boil diced potatoes for 8 minutes; drain.
Fry onion in oil, add the potatoes and fry until crisp.
Add the corned meat and paprika; fry 5 minutes.
Fry an egg per person and serve on top.

recipes.name: Corned meat in tomato & pap
recipes.description: Corned meat simmered in a chakalaka-style tomato relish.
steps: Cook the pap.
Fry onion and green pepper; add tomatoes and curry powder and simmer 5 minutes.
Add the corned meat, stir gently and heat through.
Serve with pap.

recipes.name: Mince & sweetcorn rice
recipes.description: Savoury mince with cream-style sweetcorn, a family favourite.
steps: Cook the rice.
Brown the mince with onion.
Add the sweetcorn, brown onion soup powder and half a cup of water; simmer 10 minutes.
Serve on the rice.

recipes.name: Mince & green bean stew
recipes.description: Mince and green beans in a tomato gravy, served with rice.
steps: Brown the mince with onion and garlic.
Add tomatoes, green beans and a stock cube with a cup of water.
Simmer 20 minutes until the beans are soft.
Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Mince & pumpkin stew with pap
recipes.description: Mince cooked with pumpkin and a little curry, with pap.
steps: Brown the mince with onion and curry powder.
Add cubed pumpkin, tomato paste and a cup of water.
Simmer 20 minutes until the pumpkin is soft.
Cook the pap and serve together.

recipes.name: Beef & pumpkin stew
recipes.description: Stewing beef slow-cooked with pumpkin and carrot, with rice.
steps: Brown the beef in oil with onion.
Add brown onion soup, a stock cube and three cups of water.
Cover and simmer about 1½ hours until tender.
Add pumpkin and carrot; cook 20 minutes more.
Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Meatball spaghetti
recipes.description: Homemade beef meatballs in tomato sauce with spaghetti.
steps: Mix the mince with breadcrumbs, egg, half the onion, mixed herbs and salt; roll into balls.
Brown the meatballs in oil; remove.
Fry the rest of the onion, add tomatoes and simmer 5 minutes.
Return the meatballs and simmer 15 minutes.
Boil the pasta and serve with the meatballs and sauce.

recipes.name: Curried mince toasted sandwiches
recipes.description: Pan-toasted sandwiches with curried mince and cheese.
steps: Brown the mince with onion and curry powder; add tomato paste and cook until thick.
Fill the bread with mince and grated cheese.
Spread the outsides with margarine.
Toast in a pan on both sides until golden.

recipes.name: Mince-stuffed green peppers
recipes.description: Green peppers filled with mince and rice, baked in tomato.
steps: Heat the oven to 180 °C and cook the rice.
Brown the mince with onion; mix with the rice and half the tomatoes.
Halve the peppers, remove seeds and fill with the mince.
Pour the rest of the tomatoes around, top with cheese and bake 30 minutes.

recipes.name: Mince & mushroom pasta
recipes.description: Savoury mince and mushrooms tossed through pasta.
steps: Boil the pasta.
Brown the mince with onion and garlic.
Add sliced mushrooms and fry 5 minutes.
Add tomato paste, mixed herbs and a little pasta water; simmer 5 minutes.
Toss with the pasta.

recipes.name: Beef & potato stew with bread
recipes.description: A slow beef and potato stew with fresh bread for dipping.
steps: Brown the beef with onion in a heavy pot.
Add tomatoes, a stock cube and three cups of water; simmer 1½ hours.
Add diced potatoes and carrots; simmer 25 minutes.
Serve in bowls with bread.

recipes.name: Beef frikkadels in tomato & rice
recipes.description: Spiced beef patties simmered in tomato sauce, with rice.
steps: Mix the mince with breadcrumbs, egg, grated onion and salt; shape into patties.
Brown the frikkadels in oil.
Add tomatoes and a pinch of sugar; cover and simmer 20 minutes.
Cook the rice and serve together.

recipes.name: Russians, mash & onion gravy
recipes.description: Fried Russian sausages with mash and a brown onion gravy.
steps: Boil the potatoes and mash with margarine and milk.
Fry the Russians in a pan until browned all over.
Fry sliced onion in the same pan, add soup powder mixed with a cup of water and stir until thick.
Serve the Russians with mash and gravy.

recipes.name: Russians, pap & chakalaka
recipes.description: A township classic: Russians with pap and chakalaka.
steps: Cook the pap.
Fry the Russians until browned.
Heat the chakalaka.
Serve together.

recipes.name: Sausage & bean casserole
recipes.description: Pork sausages simmered with baked beans and tomato, with bread.
steps: Brown the sausages; slice.
Fry onion, add the baked beans, tomatoes and paprika.
Return the sausages and simmer 10 minutes.
Serve with bread.

recipes.name: Pork chops & sweet potato
recipes.description: Pan-fried pork chops with boiled sweet potato and green beans.
steps: Boil the sweet potatoes until soft, about 20 minutes.
Season the chops with braai spice and fry 5 minutes a side until cooked.
Boil the green beans 6 minutes.
Serve together.

recipes.name: Viennas & vegetable rice
recipes.description: Sliced viennas fried with mixed veg and rice.
steps: Cook the rice.
Fry sliced viennas and onion in oil.
Add the frozen vegetables and cook 5 minutes.
Stir in the rice and season.

recipes.name: Polony & cabbage stir-fry
recipes.description: Strips of polony fried with cabbage and carrot on rice.
steps: Cook the rice.
Fry the polony strips and onion until golden.
Add shredded cabbage and grated carrot; fry 8 minutes.
Season with pepper and serve on rice.

recipes.name: Boerewors & potato bake
recipes.description: Boerewors baked over sliced potatoes and onion.
steps: Heat the oven to 200 °C.
Layer sliced potatoes and onion in a dish with oil, salt and a little stock.
Lay the boerewors on top.
Bake 40 minutes until the potatoes are soft and the wors is browned.

recipes.name: Boerewors tomato pasta
recipes.description: Sliced boerewors in a tomato sauce tossed with pasta.
steps: Boil the pasta.
Fry the boerewors, then slice.
Fry onion and green pepper; add tomatoes and simmer 10 minutes.
Add the wors and toss with the pasta.

recipes.name: Fish fingers, mash & peas
recipes.description: A quick kids' favourite.
steps: Boil the potatoes and mash with margarine and milk.
Fry the fish fingers in a little oil until golden, about 4 minutes a side.
Boil the peas 3 minutes.
Serve together.

recipes.name: Fish finger sandwiches
recipes.description: Crispy fish fingers in bread with mayo and cabbage slaw.
steps: Fry the fish fingers until golden.
Mix shredded cabbage and grated carrot with mayonnaise.
Fill the bread with fish fingers and slaw.

recipes.name: Pilchards, pap & chakalaka
recipes.description: Pilchards in tomato with chakalaka, the fastest pap supper.
steps: Cook the pap.
Fry onion, add the pilchards and their sauce and heat gently.
Heat the chakalaka.
Serve together.

recipes.name: Pilchard tomato pasta
recipes.description: Pilchards flaked into a garlicky tomato sauce with pasta.
steps: Boil the pasta.
Fry onion and garlic, add the tomatoes and simmer 5 minutes.
Add the pilchards, flake gently and heat through.
Toss with the pasta.

recipes.name: Tuna & sweetcorn pasta
recipes.description: Pasta with tuna, creamed sweetcorn and cheese.
steps: Boil the pasta.
Heat the sweetcorn with a little milk.
Add the drained tuna and grated cheese; stir until melted.
Toss with the pasta.

recipes.name: Tuna & sweetcorn rice
recipes.description: Rice mixed with tuna, sweetcorn and peas.
steps: Cook the rice.
Fry onion, add peas and cook 3 minutes.
Stir in the sweetcorn and drained tuna.
Mix with the rice and season.

recipes.name: Hake in tomato stew
recipes.description: Hake gently cooked in a tomato and green pepper sauce, with rice.
steps: Cook the rice.
Fry onion, garlic and green pepper; add tomatoes and paprika and simmer 8 minutes.
Lay the hake in the sauce, cover and cook 8 minutes until it flakes.
Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Oven hake & sweet potato
recipes.description: Baked hake with roasted sweet potato and green beans.
steps: Heat the oven to 200 °C; roast cubed sweet potato with oil and salt for 25 minutes.
Season the hake with paprika and mixed herbs and add to the tray.
Bake 12 minutes until the fish flakes.
Boil the green beans and serve together.

recipes.name: Tuna potato fishcakes & salad
recipes.description: Tuna and potato cakes with a simple cabbage salad.
steps: Boil and mash the potatoes.
Mix with tuna, egg, onion and a little flour; shape into cakes.
Fry until golden on both sides.
Serve with shredded cabbage and carrot.

recipes.name: Eggs in tomato sauce (shakshuka)
recipes.description: Eggs poached in a spiced tomato and pepper sauce, with bread.
steps: Fry onion, garlic and green pepper until soft.
Add tomatoes and paprika; simmer 8 minutes.
Make hollows and crack in the eggs; cover and cook 6 minutes.
Serve with bread.

recipes.name: Egg curry & rice
recipes.description: Boiled eggs in a mild tomato curry, with rice.
steps: Hard-boil the eggs for 10 minutes; peel.
Fry onion, garlic, curry powder and turmeric.
Add tomatoes and a little water; simmer 10 minutes.
Add the halved eggs and warm through. Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Potato & onion omelette
recipes.description: A thick Spanish-style omelette, cut into wedges.
steps: Thinly slice the potatoes and onion and fry gently in oil for 15 minutes until soft.
Beat the eggs with salt and pepper and pour over.
Cook on low with a lid for 10 minutes until set.
Cut into wedges.

recipes.name: French toast & baked beans
recipes.description: Eggy bread with warm baked beans.
steps: Beat the eggs with milk and a pinch of salt.
Dip the bread and fry in margarine until golden.
Heat the baked beans.
Serve together.

recipes.name: Butter bean curry & rice
recipes.description: Butter beans in a mild tomato curry, with rice.
steps: Fry onion, garlic and curry powder.
Add tomatoes and diced potato with a cup of water; simmer 15 minutes.
Add the drained butter beans and heat through.
Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Butter bean & pumpkin stew
recipes.description: Butter beans and pumpkin in a tomato stew, with pap.
steps: Fry onion and garlic.
Add pumpkin, tomatoes and a stock cube with a cup of water; simmer 15 minutes.
Add the butter beans and simmer 5 minutes.
Serve with pap.

recipes.name: Lentil bolognaise
recipes.description: A meat-free bolognaise with red lentils and carrot.
steps: Fry onion, garlic and grated carrot.
Add lentils, tomatoes, mixed herbs and two cups of water.
Simmer 25 minutes until thick, stirring.
Serve on pasta.

recipes.name: Lentil & sweet potato curry
recipes.description: Red lentils and sweet potato in a warming curry, with rice.
steps: Fry onion, garlic, curry powder and turmeric.
Add lentils, cubed sweet potato, tomatoes and two cups of water.
Simmer 25 minutes until soft.
Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Sugar bean soup & bread
recipes.description: A thick bean and vegetable soup, served with bread.
steps: Soak the beans overnight; drain.
Simmer the beans in fresh water for about 1½ hours until soft.
Add onion, carrot, potato, stock cube and tomatoes; simmer 30 minutes.
Mash some of the beans to thicken. Serve with bread.

recipes.name: Spinach with peanut & pap
recipes.description: Spinach and tomato cooked with peanut butter, with pap.
steps: Cook the pap.
Fry onion, add chopped tomato and cook 5 minutes.
Add the spinach and cook until wilted.
Stir in the peanut butter with a splash of water and simmer 3 minutes.

recipes.name: Soya mince cottage pie
recipes.description: Soya mince with vegetables under a mash topping.
steps: Heat the oven to 200 °C. Boil and mash the potatoes with margarine and milk.
Soak the soya mince 10 minutes; fry with onion and mixed veg.
Add tomato paste, soup powder and water; simmer until thick.
Spread in a dish, top with mash and bake 20 minutes.

recipes.name: Pumpkin soup & bread
recipes.description: Smooth pumpkin and onion soup with buttered bread.
steps: Fry onion in oil until soft.
Add pumpkin, potato, stock cube and water to cover; simmer 25 minutes.
Mash or blend until smooth, then stir in the milk.
Serve with bread.

recipes.name: Sweetcorn fritters & beans
recipes.description: Golden sweetcorn fritters with baked beans.
steps: Mix the sweetcorn, egg, flour, baking powder and salt into a thick batter.
Fry spoonfuls in oil until golden on both sides.
Heat the baked beans.
Serve together.

recipes.name: Vegetable curry & rice
recipes.description: Potatoes and mixed veg in a tomato curry.
steps: Fry onion, garlic, curry powder and turmeric.
Add diced potatoes, tomatoes and a cup of water; simmer 15 minutes.
Add the mixed veg and cook 8 minutes more.
Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Mushroom & spinach pasta
recipes.description: Pasta with mushrooms, spinach and a cheesy sauce.
steps: Boil the pasta.
Fry onion, garlic and mushrooms for 5 minutes; add spinach until wilted.
Stir in the milk and grated cheese until melted.
Toss with the pasta.

recipes.name: Cabbage & butter bean stew with pap
recipes.description: Cabbage and butter beans in a curry tomato relish.
steps: Fry onion and curry powder.
Add shredded cabbage and cook 8 minutes.
Add tomatoes and butter beans; simmer 8 minutes.
Serve with pap.

recipes.name: Vetkoek with chakalaka & cheese
recipes.description: Fried dough breads filled with chakalaka and cheese.
steps: Mix flour, baking powder, salt and water into a soft dough; rest 20 minutes.
Shape into balls and fry in hot oil until golden and cooked through, about 8 minutes.
Heat the chakalaka.
Split the vetkoek and fill with chakalaka and grated cheese.

recipes.name: Steamed bread (ujeqe) & bean stew
recipes.description: Pot-steamed bread with a sugar bean and tomato stew.
steps: Soak the beans overnight; simmer about 1½ hours until soft.
Mix flour, baking powder, sugar, salt and water into a dough; place in a greased bowl.
Steam the bowl in a covered pot of simmering water for 1 hour.
Fry onion, add tomatoes and the beans; simmer 15 minutes.
Serve the steamed bread with the stew.

recipes.name: Tomato soup & cheese toasties
recipes.description: Quick tomato soup with toasted cheese sandwiches.
steps: Fry onion and garlic, add tomatoes, a stock cube, sugar and a cup of water; simmer 15 minutes.
Mash or blend the soup.
Make cheese sandwiches, spread the outsides with margarine and toast in a pan.
Serve the soup with toasties.

recipes.name: Sweet potato & lentil soup
recipes.description: A thick, warming soup with bread.
steps: Fry onion and curry powder.
Add lentils, cubed sweet potato, carrot, a stock cube and four cups of water.
Simmer 25 minutes until soft; mash lightly.
Serve with bread.

recipes.name: Cabbage & egg stir-fry with pap
recipes.description: Cabbage fried with onion and scrambled egg, with pap.
steps: Cook the pap.
Fry onion and shredded cabbage for 8 minutes.
Push to one side, scramble the eggs in the pan and mix through.
Season and serve with pap.

recipes.name: Green bean & potato bredie
recipes.description: A meat-free green bean bredie with potato, served with rice.
steps: Fry onion until golden.
Add green beans, diced potato, tomato and a stock cube with a cup of water.
Simmer 25 minutes until very soft, stirring now and then.
Season and serve with rice.

recipes.name: Chakalaka omelette & bread
recipes.description: A fluffy omelette filled with chakalaka and cheese.
steps: Beat the eggs with salt.
Cook in a hot oiled pan until nearly set.
Spoon chakalaka and grated cheese on one half, fold and cook 1 minute.
Serve with bread.

recipes.name: Mushroom rice with boiled eggs
recipes.description: One-pot mushroom and onion rice with boiled eggs.
steps: Fry onion and mushrooms until golden.
Add the rice, a stock cube and water; cover and cook 18 minutes.
Boil the eggs for 10 minutes and peel.
Serve the rice topped with halved eggs.

recipes.name: Bean bunny chow
recipes.description: A hollowed bread loaf filled with curried beans and potato.
steps: Fry onion, garlic and curry powder.
Add diced potato, tomatoes and water; simmer 15 minutes.
Add the cooked or tinned beans and baked beans; simmer 5 minutes.
Hollow out a quarter loaf per person and fill with the curry.

recipes.name: Chicken bunny chow
recipes.description: Durban-style chicken and potato curry in a hollowed loaf.
steps: Brown the chicken with onion, garlic, curry powder and turmeric.
Add tomatoes, diced potato and a cup of water; simmer 30 minutes.
Hollow out a quarter loaf per person.
Fill with the curry and use the bread plug for dipping.

recipes.name: Mince bunny chow
recipes.description: Curried mince and potato in a hollowed quarter loaf.
steps: Brown the mince with onion, garlic and curry powder.
Add diced potato, tomatoes and water; simmer 20 minutes.
Hollow out a quarter loaf per person and fill with the curry.

recipes.name: Garlic & chilli spaghetti with a fried egg
recipes.description: Spaghetti tossed in garlic oil and chilli, topped with a fried egg.
steps: Boil the spaghetti in salted water.
Gently fry sliced garlic and chilli powder in the oil for 1 minute; don't let it burn.
Toss the drained pasta in the garlic oil with a splash of pasta water.
Fry an egg per person and serve on top with grated cheese.

recipes.name: Tuna & sweetcorn wraps
recipes.description: No-cook wraps with tuna, sweetcorn, cucumber and mayo.
steps: Drain the tuna and mix with sweetcorn, mayonnaise and black pepper.
Slice the cucumber and tomato.
Fill the wraps, roll up tightly and cut in half.

recipes.name: Bean & cheese quesadillas
recipes.description: Crispy wraps filled with spiced beans and melted cheese.
steps: Mash the drained beans with cumin, paprika and a pinch of salt.
Spread on half of each wrap, add grated cheese and fold over.
Toast in a dry pan for 2–3 minutes a side until golden and melted.
Cut into wedges and serve with chopped tomato.

recipes.name: Vegetable egg-noodle stir-fry
recipes.description: Noodles stir-fried with vegetables, egg and soy sauce.
steps: Soak or boil the noodles as the packet says; drain.
Stir-fry the frozen vegetables, garlic and ginger in hot oil for 4 minutes.
Push aside, scramble the eggs, then add the noodles and soy sauce.
Toss everything together for 2 minutes.

recipes.name: Feta & spinach omelette
recipes.description: A quick omelette with spinach and feta, with toast.
steps: Wilt the spinach in a little oil; set aside.
Beat the eggs with pepper and pour into the hot pan.
When nearly set, add the spinach and crumbled feta, fold and cook 1 minute.
Serve with toast.

recipes.name: Creamy tuna & pea pasta
recipes.description: Pasta in a quick cheesy milk sauce with tuna and peas.
steps: Boil the pasta; add the peas for the last 3 minutes.
Melt margarine, stir in the flour, then whisk in the milk until thick.
Stir in grated cheese and the drained tuna.
Toss with the pasta and peas.

recipes.name: Vienna carbonara
recipes.description: A family-friendly carbonara with viennas, egg and cheese.
steps: Boil the pasta.
Fry the sliced viennas and garlic until golden.
Beat the egg with grated cheese and black pepper.
Off the heat, toss the hot pasta with the viennas and egg mix until creamy, adding a splash of pasta water.

recipes.name: Scrambled eggs & tomato on toast
recipes.description: Soft scrambled eggs with fried tomato on toast.
steps: Fry thick tomato slices in a little margarine; season.
Beat the eggs with milk and salt and scramble gently on low heat.
Serve on buttered toast with the tomato.

recipes.name: Chicken mayo wraps
recipes.description: Shredded chicken, crunchy cabbage and mayo in a wrap.
steps: Slice the chicken thinly and fry in oil with paprika for 6 minutes.
Mix shredded cabbage and grated carrot with mayonnaise.
Fill the wraps with chicken and slaw and roll up.

recipes.name: Wrap pizzas
recipes.description: Crispy pan pizzas on wraps with tomato, cheese and toppings.
steps: Mix tomato paste with mixed herbs and a little water.
Spread on the wraps, top with sliced green pepper, onion and grated cheese.
Cook in a covered pan on medium heat for 4–5 minutes until the base is crisp and the cheese melts.

recipes.name: Hot dogs with slaw
recipes.description: Viennas in rolls with tomato sauce and cabbage slaw.
steps: Simmer the viennas in water for 5 minutes.
Mix shredded cabbage and carrot with mayonnaise.
Fry sliced onion until soft.
Fill the rolls with viennas, onion and slaw.

recipes.name: Thai-style peanut noodles
recipes.description: Noodles in a quick peanut, soy and ginger sauce with vegetables.
steps: Cook the noodles; drain.
Whisk peanut butter, soy sauce, grated ginger, a pinch of sugar and hot water into a sauce.
Stir-fry grated carrot and shredded cabbage for 3 minutes.
Toss the noodles and vegetables in the sauce.

recipes.name: Tuna, tomato & cucumber sandwiches
recipes.description: A light no-cook supper for hot evenings.
steps: Mix the tuna with mayonnaise, lemon juice and pepper.
Slice the tomato and cucumber.
Build the sandwiches and cut in half.

recipes.name: Chickpea, feta & cucumber wraps
recipes.description: Smashed chickpeas with lemon, feta and cucumber in wraps.
steps: Lightly mash the drained chickpeas with lemon juice, cumin and salt.
Add crumbled feta, diced cucumber and tomato.
Spoon into the wraps and roll up.

recipes.name: Penne arrabbiata
recipes.description: Pasta in a spicy garlic and tomato sauce.
steps: Boil the pasta.
Fry garlic and chilli powder in oil for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and a pinch of sugar; simmer 8 minutes.
Toss with the pasta and top with grated cheese.

recipes.name: Fried noodles with egg & polony
recipes.description: Quick fried noodles with polony strips and cabbage.
steps: Cook the noodles; drain.
Fry polony strips and shredded cabbage for 4 minutes.
Add the noodles, soy sauce and a beaten egg; toss until the egg sets.

recipes.name: Chakalaka beans on toast
recipes.description: Warm chakalaka and baked beans on toast with cheese.
steps: Heat the baked beans and chakalaka together.
Toast and butter the bread.
Spoon the beans over and top with grated cheese.

recipes.name: Chicken & pepper quesadillas
recipes.description: Spiced chicken, peppers and cheese toasted in wraps.
steps: Slice the chicken, pepper and onion; fry with cumin and paprika for 8 minutes.
Spread over half of each wrap, add cheese and fold.
Toast in a dry pan until golden on both sides.
Cut into wedges.

recipes.name: Chicken fajitas
recipes.description: Sizzling spiced chicken strips with peppers and onion in wraps.
steps: Slice the chicken, pepper and onion into strips.
Toss the chicken with cumin, paprika, chilli powder, lemon juice and salt.
Fry the chicken on high heat for 6 minutes, add the vegetables and fry 4 minutes more.
Serve in warm wraps with chopped tomato.

recipes.name: Beef mince soft tacos
recipes.description: Spiced mince in wraps with cabbage, tomato and cheese.
steps: Brown the mince with onion, garlic, cumin, paprika and chilli powder.
Add tomato paste and a splash of water; cook until thick.
Fill the wraps with mince, shredded cabbage, tomato and grated cheese.

recipes.name: Fish tacos with lemon slaw
recipes.description: Paprika hake in wraps with crunchy lemon slaw.
steps: Season the hake with paprika, cumin and salt; fry 3 minutes a side until it flakes.
Toss shredded cabbage and carrot with mayonnaise and lemon juice.
Fill the wraps with flaked fish and slaw.

recipes.name: Chicken chow mein
recipes.description: Egg noodles with chicken, cabbage and carrot in soy sauce.
steps: Cook the noodles; drain.
Stir-fry thin chicken strips with garlic and ginger for 5 minutes.
Add shredded cabbage and carrot; stir-fry 3 minutes.
Add the noodles, soy sauce and a pinch of sugar; toss until hot.

recipes.name: Ginger soy mince noodles
recipes.description: Savoury mince with ginger and soy, tossed through noodles.
steps: Cook the noodles; drain.
Brown the mince with garlic and ginger.
Add shredded cabbage, soy sauce and a pinch of sugar; cook 4 minutes.
Toss with the noodles.

recipes.name: Ginger soy chicken stir-fry
recipes.description: Chicken and vegetables in a glossy ginger soy sauce, with rice.
steps: Cook the rice.
Stir-fry chicken pieces in hot oil for 5 minutes.
Add garlic, ginger, green pepper and carrot; stir-fry 3 minutes.
Add soy sauce, sugar and a little water mixed with a teaspoon of flour; cook until glossy.
Serve on the rice.

recipes.name: Sweet & sour chicken
recipes.description: Chicken pieces in a tangy tomato, vinegar and pepper sauce.
steps: Cook the rice.
Fry the chicken pieces until golden.
Add onion and green pepper; fry 3 minutes.
Stir in tomato paste, vinegar, sugar, soy sauce and a little water; simmer 5 minutes until glossy.
Serve with the rice.

recipes.name: Thai-style coconut chicken curry
recipes.description: Chicken simmered in coconut milk with ginger and curry, on rice.
steps: Fry onion, garlic, ginger and curry powder for 2 minutes.
Add the chicken pieces and brown lightly.
Pour in the coconut milk and simmer 12 minutes.
Stir in a squeeze of lemon and serve on rice.

recipes.name: Coconut lentil dhal
recipes.description: Creamy red lentils with coconut milk, cumin and turmeric.
steps: Fry onion, garlic, ginger, cumin and turmeric for 2 minutes.
Add the lentils, tomatoes and two cups of water; simmer 15 minutes.
Stir in the coconut milk and cook 5 minutes until creamy.
Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Chickpea curry (chana masala)
recipes.description: Chickpeas in a spiced tomato and onion gravy.
steps: Fry onion, garlic and ginger until soft.
Add cumin, curry powder and turmeric; fry 1 minute.
Add tomatoes and the drained chickpeas; simmer 12 minutes.
Finish with a squeeze of lemon and serve with rice.

recipes.name: Potato & pea curry (aloo matar)
recipes.description: A comforting potato and pea curry with rice.
steps: Fry onion, garlic, ginger, cumin and curry powder.
Add diced potatoes, tomatoes and a cup of water; simmer 15 minutes.
Add the peas and cook 5 minutes.
Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Easy butter chicken
recipes.description: Chicken in a mild, creamy tomato curry sauce.
steps: Fry the chicken pieces in margarine until lightly browned.
Add onion, garlic, ginger, curry powder, cumin and a pinch of cinnamon; fry 2 minutes.
Add tomatoes and a pinch of sugar; simmer 12 minutes.
Stir in the milk and simmer 3 minutes. Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Chicken curry with roti
recipes.description: Durban-style chicken and potato curry with homemade roti.
steps: Brown the chicken with onion, garlic, ginger, curry powder and turmeric.
Add tomatoes, diced potato and a cup of water; simmer 30 minutes.
Meanwhile mix flour, salt, a little oil and water into a soft dough; rest 10 minutes.
Roll thin rounds and cook in a dry pan for 1 minute a side, brushing with margarine.
Serve the curry with roti.

recipes.name: Chicken shawarma-style wraps
recipes.description: Cumin and paprika chicken in wraps with cucumber and garlic mayo.
steps: Toss sliced chicken with cumin, paprika, cinnamon, garlic, lemon juice and oil.
Fry on high heat for 8 minutes until charred and cooked.
Mix mayonnaise with a little crushed garlic and lemon.
Fill the wraps with chicken, cucumber, tomato and garlic mayo.

recipes.name: Lentils & rice with crispy onions (mujadara)
recipes.description: Spiced lentils and rice topped with sweet fried onions.
steps: Slowly fry sliced onions in oil until deep golden; set half aside.
Add cumin and cinnamon to the pot, then the rice, lentils and two cups of water.
Cover and cook 18 minutes until tender.
Serve topped with the crispy onions and chopped cucumber and tomato.

recipes.name: Chickpea & tomato stew
recipes.description: A smoky chickpea and tomato stew with bread for dipping.
steps: Fry onion, garlic and green pepper.
Add cumin and paprika, then tomatoes and the chickpeas.
Simmer 12 minutes until thick; crumble feta on top.
Serve with bread.

recipes.name: Tomato & feta pasta
recipes.description: Pasta in a sweet tomato sauce with melted feta.
steps: Boil the pasta.
Fry onion and garlic, add tomatoes and mixed herbs; simmer 8 minutes.
Crumble in the feta and stir until it softens.
Toss with the pasta.

recipes.name: Greek lemon chicken & potatoes
recipes.description: Chicken and potatoes roasted with lemon, garlic and herbs.
steps: Heat the oven to 200 °C.
Toss potato wedges and chicken with lemon juice, garlic, mixed herbs, oil and salt.
Roast 45 minutes, turning once, until golden and cooked through.
Serve with a cucumber and tomato salad with feta.

recipes.name: Pasta napoletana
recipes.description: Classic tomato, garlic and herb pasta.
steps: Boil the pasta.
Fry onion and garlic, add tomatoes, mixed herbs and a pinch of sugar; simmer 10 minutes.
Toss with the pasta and top with grated cheese.

recipes.name: Minestrone soup
recipes.description: Hearty vegetable, bean and pasta soup.
steps: Fry onion, carrot and garlic for 5 minutes.
Add tomatoes, a stock cube, mixed herbs and four cups of water; simmer 10 minutes.
Add the pasta, beans and cabbage; simmer 10 minutes more.
Serve with grated cheese.

recipes.name: Chicken & mushroom one-pot rice
recipes.description: Risotto-style rice with chicken and mushrooms.
steps: Brown chicken pieces with onion and garlic.
Add mushrooms and fry 3 minutes.
Add the rice, a stock cube and water; cover and cook 18 minutes.
Stir in milk and grated cheese until creamy.

recipes.name: Chilli con carne
recipes.description: Beef mince and kidney beans in a spiced tomato sauce, with rice.
steps: Brown the mince with onion, garlic and green pepper.
Add cumin, paprika and chilli powder; fry 1 minute.
Add tomatoes and the drained kidney beans; simmer 20 minutes.
Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Three-bean chilli
recipes.description: A meat-free chilli with kidney beans, baked beans and butter beans.
steps: Fry onion, garlic and green pepper.
Add cumin, paprika and chilli powder.
Add tomatoes and all the beans; simmer 15 minutes.
Serve with rice and grated cheese.

recipes.name: Burrito rice bowls
recipes.description: Cumin rice with beans, sweetcorn, tomato and cheese.
steps: Cook the rice with a pinch of cumin.
Warm the beans with paprika and a splash of water.
Fill bowls with rice, beans, sweetcorn, chopped tomato, cucumber and grated cheese.
Squeeze over lemon.

recipes.name: Homemade beef burgers
recipes.description: Juicy mince patties in rolls with tomato, onion and cucumber.
steps: Mix the mince with grated onion, egg, salt and pepper; shape into patties.
Fry the patties 4–5 minutes a side until cooked through.
Toast the rolls in the pan.
Build the burgers with tomato, cucumber and mayonnaise.

recipes.name: Crumbed chicken burgers
recipes.description: Crispy crumbed chicken fillets in rolls with slaw.
steps: Flatten the fillets, dip in beaten egg, then in flour seasoned with paprika and salt.
Fry 4 minutes a side until golden and cooked through.
Mix shredded cabbage and carrot with mayonnaise.
Serve in toasted rolls with the slaw.

recipes.name: Sloppy joes
recipes.description: Saucy tomato mince piled onto rolls.
steps: Brown the mince with onion and green pepper.
Add tomato paste, a little vinegar, sugar and water; simmer 10 minutes until thick.
Spoon into toasted rolls.

recipes.name: Chicken & sweetcorn chowder
recipes.description: Creamy chicken, potato and sweetcorn soup with bread.
steps: Fry onion and diced chicken for 5 minutes.
Add diced potato, a stock cube and two cups of water; simmer 12 minutes.
Add the sweetcorn and milk; simmer 5 minutes.
Season and serve with bread.

recipes.name: Bangers, mash & peas
recipes.description: Pork sausages with creamy mash, peas and onion gravy.
steps: Boil and mash the potatoes with margarine and milk.
Fry the sausages until browned and cooked through.
Fry onion in the same pan, add soup powder mixed with water and stir until thick.
Boil the peas and serve everything together.

recipes.name: Oven fish & chips
recipes.description: Crumbed hake and oven chips with lemon.
steps: Heat the oven to 220 °C. Toss potato chips with oil and salt and bake 35 minutes, turning once.
Dip the hake in beaten egg, then flour seasoned with paprika.
Pan-fry the fish 3–4 minutes a side until golden.
Serve with lemon wedges and peas.

recipes.name: Toad in the hole
recipes.description: Sausages baked in a puffy batter, with onion gravy.
steps: Heat the oven to 220 °C. Brown the sausages in an oven dish with the oil for 10 minutes.
Whisk flour, eggs, milk and salt into a smooth batter.
Pour the batter over the hot sausages and bake 25 minutes until risen and golden; don't open the oven.
Serve with onion gravy and green beans.

recipes.name: Bobotie & yellow rice
recipes.description: Cape Malay spiced mince baked with an egg custard, with turmeric rice.
steps: Heat the oven to 180 °C. Soak a slice of bread in some of the milk.
Fry onion with curry powder, turmeric and cinnamon; add the mince and brown.
Mix in the soaked bread, chutney and a little vinegar; spread in a dish.
Beat the egg with the rest of the milk, pour over and bake 30 minutes until set.
Cook the rice with turmeric and a pinch of sugar and serve with the bobotie.

recipes.name: Cape Malay chicken curry
recipes.description: A fragrant, mildly sweet chicken and potato curry.
steps: Fry onion, garlic and ginger with curry powder, turmeric, cumin and cinnamon.
Brown the chicken in the spices.
Add tomatoes, diced potato, a spoon of chutney and a cup of water; simmer 30 minutes.
Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Chicken akhni
recipes.description: Cape Malay one-pot spiced chicken, potato and rice.
steps: Brown the chicken with onion, garlic, ginger, curry powder, turmeric and cinnamon.
Add tomatoes and diced potatoes with a cup of water; simmer 15 minutes.
Stir in the rice and enough water to cover; cover and cook on low for 20 minutes.
Fluff up and serve.

recipes.name: Mince tamatiebredie
recipes.description: Afrikaans-style tomato stew made quicker with mince, served on rice.
steps: Brown the mince with onion.
Add tomatoes, diced potato, a pinch of sugar, cinnamon and a stock cube with a cup of water.
Simmer 25 minutes until the potatoes are soft and the sauce is thick.
Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Wors with pumpkin fritters
recipes.description: Boerewors with sweet pampoenkoekies and stywe pap.
steps: Boil the pumpkin until soft; mash and mix with flour, egg, baking powder and a pinch of cinnamon.
Fry spoonfuls in oil until golden; sprinkle with a little sugar.
Fry the boerewors.
Cook stiff pap and serve together.

recipes.name: Chicken potjie
recipes.description: Layered chicken and vegetables slow-cooked in one pot.
steps: Brown the chicken and onion in a heavy pot.
Layer potatoes, carrots, butternut and green beans on top; don't stir.
Pour in a stock cube dissolved in a cup of water with braai spice.
Cover and cook on low heat for about 1 hour until tender.

recipes.name: Peri-peri chicken wraps
recipes.description: Portuguese-style peri-peri chicken strips with lemon mayo.
steps: Toss chicken strips with peri-peri spice, garlic, lemon juice and oil.
Fry on high heat for 8 minutes.
Mix mayonnaise with lemon.
Fill the wraps with chicken, lettuce-style shredded cabbage, tomato and lemon mayo.

recipes.name: Chicken prego rolls
recipes.description: Garlicky peri-peri chicken fillets in rolls, Portuguese-style.
steps: Flatten the fillets and marinate briefly in garlic, peri-peri spice, lemon and oil.
Fry 4 minutes a side until cooked.
Splash in a little water and margarine to make a quick pan sauce.
Serve in toasted rolls with the sauce.

recipes.name: Portuguese-style chicken & rice
recipes.description: Paprika and garlic chicken cooked with rice, peppers and peas.
steps: Brown the chicken with paprika, garlic and peri-peri spice.
Add onion and green pepper; fry 3 minutes.
Add tomatoes, the rice and two cups of water; cover and cook 20 minutes.
Stir in the peas for the last 5 minutes.

recipes.name: Lemon & garlic hake with rice
recipes.description: Pan-fried hake in lemon garlic butter, with rice and green beans.
steps: Cook the rice.
Season the hake and fry 3 minutes a side.
Add margarine, garlic and lemon juice to the pan and spoon over the fish.
Boil the green beans and serve together.

recipes.name: Durban mince & pea curry with roti
recipes.description: A quick mince and pea curry with homemade roti.
steps: Fry onion, garlic, ginger and curry powder; add the mince and brown.
Add tomatoes, peas and a little water; simmer 15 minutes.
Make a soft dough with flour, salt, a little oil and water; rest 10 minutes.
Roll thin and cook the roti in a dry pan, brushing with margarine.
Serve together.

recipes.name: Pap, tomato relish & fried eggs
recipes.description: Quick weeknight pap with a tomato-onion relish and eggs.
steps: Cook the pap.
Fry onion, add chopped tomato and a pinch of sugar; cook 8 minutes into a relish.
Fry the eggs.
Serve the pap with relish and eggs.

recipes.name: Pork chops with pap & tomato salsa
recipes.description: Pan-grilled braai-spice chops with pap and a fresh salsa.
steps: Cook the pap.
Rub the chops with braai spice and pan-grill 5 minutes a side.
Mix chopped tomato, onion and cucumber with a dash of vinegar and salt.
Serve together.

recipes.name: Chicken noodle soup
recipes.description: Light, comforting soup with chicken, carrot and noodles.
steps: Simmer diced chicken with onion, carrot, garlic, ginger and a stock cube in four cups of water for 12 minutes.
Add the noodles and cook 4 minutes.
Season with soy sauce and serve.

recipes.name: Greek egg & lemon chicken rice soup
recipes.description: Avgolemono-style soup: chicken, rice and a silky egg-lemon finish.
steps: Simmer diced chicken, onion and a stock cube in four cups of water for 10 minutes.
Add the rice and cook 15 minutes.
Whisk the egg with lemon juice, then whisk in a ladle of hot soup.
Stir the egg mix into the pot off the heat until silky.
